title: GMT portal FormSubmit envelope contract
description: Machine-readable fields emitted by the static portal's FormSubmit routes. Task requests use the protected Worker API described in taskWorkflow and are no longer emitted as FormSubmit envelopes.

timesheet.attachmentRule: Accept only non-inline XLSX, CSV, GMT Timesheet Record JSON and GMT Calendar Sync JSON files. Filter array stores the four controlled file classes; Filter array 2 selects the record JSON for the Excel upsert. Reject every other JSON or inline attachment.

estimate.routing: The protected Microsoft 365 flow validates the client recipient and approved Accounts BCC route, stores the estimate in GMT Web-App/Estimates/{year}/{month}/{estimate-number}/, records status in the Estimates list, and sends from the approved GMT mailbox.

clockEvent.absenceRule: An absent event must contain gmt_absence_reason and records zero worked/OT hours.

actions.retryRule: A retry reuses the original taskId and actionId and returns the original outcome after a confirmed sync.

task.authority: The company-owned Microsoft Tasks List row is authoritative. Worker D1 is a protected mirror, idempotent outbox, and activity log.

taskWorkflow.concurrencyRule: Compare current List values with event.changes.from and apply updates with the row ETag. On an ETag conflict, re-read and reject stale changes instead of overwriting newer state.
taskWorkflow.actionLog: Task Workflow Actions has a unique Action ID, Started/Completed/Failed status, stored outcome, and error. Return a stored Completed outcome for a retry; resume a Started action by checking Last Action ID and intended values before any repeated write.
taskWorkflow.calendarRule: Create an Outlook event only for an approved dated task; update by stored Outlook Event ID and retain completed or cancelled events.

authority.browser: Submits tasks and calendar requests. The Worker permits requesters to cancel their own pending tasks, assigned staff to progress approved work, and Accounts/Operations to approve, reject, assign, schedule, or cancel.
authority.worker: Validates the signed Entra identity, enforces role and task ownership, and calls only the protected Power Automate task endpoint.
authority.microsoft365: The Microsoft Tasks List stores authoritative task state. Controlled flows write List records and create/update Outlook calendar events; browser code has no direct List or calendar write path.
